presentation.label: CHOPDLY
presentation.summary: A delay that chops what it recorded: every repeat replays the last cycle cut into 1-16 chops (or at your notes), rearranged, reversed, pitched and stretched, and the repeats get re-chopped.

controls.name: Time
controls.doc: params[5]. Cycle/delay length 30 ms .. 2.5 s, squared curve (45 = ~0.53 s). Range 0–100.

controls.name: Chops
controls.doc: params[6]. Named steps: 0 = Trans (cut at note attacks; none found: 4 equal), 1..16 = equal chops. Range 0–16.

controls.name: Order
controls.doc: params[7]. Named steps: Fwd, Back (chops in reverse order), Swap (pairs swapped), Skip (evens then odds), Stutr (each other chop twice), Build (0, 01, 012...), Mix1-8 (fixed shuffles, every chop once), Rpt1-6 (fixed, chops may repeat or drop), Rand (new shuffle every cycle), Chaos (new random with repeats every cycle). Range 0–21.

controls.name: Pitch
controls.doc: params[8]. Named steps: -12/-7/-5/Unity/+5/+7/+12 = all chops; Oct+ / Oct- = half the chops up / down an octave; Octs = a third up, a third down; Fifth = a third +7, a third -5; Some = half the chops jump +-5/7/12; Wild = every chop jumps. Fixed per-slot coins, so it recalls. Varispeed unless Stretch is on. Range 0–12.

controls.name: Rev
controls.doc: params[9]. Named steps: Off, Few (1/4 of chops), Alt (every other chop), Half, Most (3/4), All, Ping (chops alternate L/R, forward), Scatr (each chop a fixed pan, forward). Fixed per-slot coins. Range 0–7.

controls.name: Strch
controls.doc: params[10]. Named steps: 1/4, 1/3, 1/2, 3/4 = slower, Off = plain read, 1.5x, 2x = faster; how fast each chop runs through its audio with pitch kept (two-grain crossfade, 46 ms grains). Pitch still applies on top. Range 0–6.

controls.name: Glide
controls.doc: params[11]. Chop edges: 0 = cut where chopped (32-sample anti-click fade); higher = longer fades and the ending chop overlaps the next one (crossfade). 100 = half the shorter chop. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Feed
controls.doc: params[12]. Chopped output back into the recording (0 .. 0.95), limited. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
